import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Standardize island names to the allowed values
    island_map = {
        "Bisco": "Biscoe",
        "Biscoe": "Biscoe",
        "Dream ": "Dream",
        "Dream": "Dream",
        "Torgerson": "Torgersen",
        "Torgersen": "Torgersen"
    }
    df["island"] = df["island"].astype(str).str.strip().replace(island_map)

    # Standardize sex values
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({"female": "female", "male": "male"})

    # Convert numeric-like text columns to numbers
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(",", ""), errors="coerce"
    )
    for col in ["flipper_length_mm", "year"]:
        if df[col].dtype == object:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["island"])
    counts = d.groupby("island").size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
